name: mol4agent
description: Open PDB/mmCIF/SDF structures in an interactive Mol* viewer that the agent can operate with mol_* tools.

interface.longDescription: Open molecular structure files in Mol*'s official 3D viewer inside ChatGPT/Codex. The agent can change representations and colors, highlight residues or ligands, focus the camera, measure distances, and capture PNG figures while the viewer updates live.
defaultPrompt: Open fixtures/1atp.pdb, show cartoon colored by chain, highlight ATP, and capture a screenshot
Find the interface residues between chains A and B in fixtures/7czd.pdb
Show fixtures/aspirin.sdf as ball-and-stick and label the molecule
